name: Mountain View Open 2017
information: The registration fee is $15. There is a 90 person competitor limit with no at-the-door registration. To register, please follow all instructions on the registration payment tab. Improper completion of these steps may result in a delay of registration. If you do not see your name on the competitors tab within 48 hours of registering, please contact me to resolve the issue. We will be holding Rubik’s Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, Rubik’s Cube: Blindfolded, Rubik’s Cube: With Feet, Skewb, Square-1, Unofficial: Kilominx on day 1 and 5x5x5 Cube, Megaminx, Rubik’s Clock, 4x4x4 Cube: Blindfolded, 5x5x5 Cube: Blindfolded, Rubik’s Cube: Multiple Blindfolded on day 2 as Qualifying Events (see events tab for more information).
